main.description: Give an instance a new encryption key. The old key stays beside it while HappyView re-seals what it sealed, and is then retired on its own. Staff only.

idempotencyKey.description: A UUID. Repeating a request with the same key replays its answer.

errors.name: AuthRequired
errors.description: This endpoint requires an authenticated caller.

errors.name: Forbidden
errors.description: The caller is not HappyProto staff, or the provisioner does not treat them as staff.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The input was malformed, or the provisioner refused it as malformed.

errors.name: NotFound
errors.description: No such instance, or it has been deleted.

errors.name: OperationInProgress
errors.description: Another operation is in progress for the instance.

errors.name: RotationInProgress
errors.description: The instance is already part-way through a rotation: its old key is not retired yet.

errors.name: InstanceStopped
errors.description: The instance is stopped. Start it first.

errors.name: NotLive
errors.description: The instance has not gone live yet.

errors.name: RotationUnsupported
errors.description: The instance's HappyView cannot report a key rotation. Upgrade it first.

errors.name: AgentUnreachable
errors.description: The instance's host did not answer, so the provisioner could not check it.

errors.name: NotSettled
errors.description: The instance isn't running what an apply would send it now: it's failed, or a change such as a version bump hasn't been applied. Retry the instance first.

errors.name: Upstream
errors.description: The provisioner is unreachable, not configured, or answered with an error it does not explain to callers.
